children: Two short positions held by a Hyperliquid trader were liquidated, resulting in a combined loss of $47,900. According to Odaily, the BTC short was valued at $4.29 million and lost $46,070, while the ZEC short was valued at $61,880 and lost $1,800. The trader had deposited $200,000 in USDC hours earlier in an attempt to save the positions and still holds $17.36 million in open shorts, with unrealized losses of $149,900.

title: Hyperliquid Trader's BTC and ZEC Shorts Liquidated, Still Holds $17.36 Million in Shorts
